spans.text: Pzzt... Pzzzt...
I can't believe... I failed...
The spherical barrier around Laplace's Demon pops like a bubble, creating little sparks that fizzle in the air.
Her body falls apart block by block. She looks almost like a pile of toy parts from a distance.
Hehehehe... Hahahahaha!
I failed! I failed!
Have they lost their mind?
Bang!
The scalding barrel of a gun smacks Laplace's Demon hard on the head, leaving an ugly dent.
Hahahaha... Lady Lunasia has finally shown herself!
She has returned! I have witnessed this miracle with my own eyes! I really am the all-knowing, all-powerful Laplace's Demon!
M4, you're saying she's not a servant of God, but an imposter?
Yes... That's what the voice is telling me...
That would be Lady Lunasia.
Fine, I'll admit it—I AM an imposter.
Here, do you want to see what this place is actually like?
Crack.
A small rift starts spreading from the palm of her hand.
A white ball of string suddenly rolls down and traces a beautiful doorway in front of the winding staircase.
The servant of God is an irresponsible bastard who only cares about having fun.
But I'm not like that. I'm very hardworking.
Why... can't I move?
Neither can I.
Relax. I can't move either.
...What's the meaning of this?
I'm just a steward, while you are all vessels that facilitate Lady Lunasia's awakening.
Only a complete vessel will be able to host Lady Lunasia.
Who is Lady Lunasia? M4A1, you know the answer to that perfectly well, no? She is inside you.
...You lied to us!
I didn't.
I would never deceive you.
Lady Lunasia, please allow me to offer my power for your birth.
Heheh... You are running out of time...
I really... look forward... to...
As the mechanical whirring finally comes to a stop, Laplace's Demon also grows still and lifeless.
A beam of pale white light pierces through the clouds and shines down from above.
...Who are you?
You should know.
We are both Lunasia.
Is this... my fate?
Maybe, maybe not.
The choice is yours.
I thought you'd have a lot of questions for me.
I had thought the same before I met you.
So will you help me?
Help you?
Hand over everything to me. Your memories, your emotions, all your data...
Your soul and your life.
But that would leave me with nothing, wouldn't it?
...That's true.
You will become a part of me and fill in the final missing puzzle piece to "Lunasia's" existence.
Time is static here. Take as much time as you need to consider it.
Give me a reason why I'd do this.
A reason?
Lunasia holds out her hands. Thousands of threads flow from her fingers like a river network, interweaving and crisscrossing across the desolate land...
What's this?!
These are the threads of all lives in this world.
They intertwine, entangle, separate, break...
Lunasia picks up one of the broken threads.
I have no control over where these threads go, because the choice is not mine.
What I can do is give them another chance to flow.
Lunasia places the other end of the thread in M4's palm.
The moment it makes contact, a cool and firm sensation wraps around M4's hand.
Then it suddenly disappears.
Leaving only pure white and eternal silence.
The Paradeus forces batter the AR Team's fragile defenses like the rising tide.
Morridow stands within the Commander's sight. Beside her, Machlian's cold body lies rumpled on the ground like a rag.
The Commander glares at Morridow with burning hatred.
However, there is nothing they can do.
How dare you hurt me so badly!
Big Sis! Can I kill them all? I can kill them all, right?!
Yes, you may.
Nimogen must be kept alive, but you can kill the rest and do whatever you want with them.
...That really pisses me off.
ST AR-15 takes out her pistol, her other hand holding her combat knife in a reverse grip.
Even if I have to die, I'm going to wipe that smile off her face.
The AR Team's steadfast resistance has almost wiped out the Paradeus forces.
However, Narciss and Morridow still stand in their way, like two mighty peaks that cannot be scaled.
The Dolls have pushed their bodies to the limit.
They stand in front of the Commander and Dandelion, their bodies covered in fresh blood.
Pzzzt...
There is still no response from the communicator.
...Do you regret going on this mission with me?
Carrying out missions under your command has been the greatest honor of my life, Commander.
I, on the other hand, regret not having a few more drinks with you, Commander.
I... I want to see M4 and M16 again!
The Commander gazes at the overwhelming number of Paradeus reinforcements, as well as Morridow and Narciss, who stand among them.
Even if we die here...
You will never succeed.
There is no path for Paradeus which does not end in its destruction.
...I'll see you in Hell.
What a talker. I can see why Frau Ange likes you.
Morridow sneers disdainfully.
Your corpses will be buried here, relegated to the dust of history along with everything in this place, and nobody will even remember you.
You are garbage that has been cast off by the times, ants ground to bits under the wheel of Paradeus.
...Your sacrifice will be meaningless, just like that of my foolish big sister.
The Commander... and the AR Team...
They seem to be severely injured.
That's right. The Commander's thread will break here.
Lunasia points at the threat in M4's hand.
Do something! Don't let it break!
That is indeed something we can do.
Lunasia gazes quietly at M4.
Only by becoming Lunasia will we be able to reconnect broken threads.
M4's tears suddenly start falling.
There's no need to be so sad. I can give you a chance to try.
...What do you mean?
We can try to... merge for a bit.
If you change your mind, we will separate again after a while.
And I'll keep waiting for you here.
Do you not have any feelings?
I used to, but that was a very long time ago.
Everyone thinks you are the only hope of saving the world.
I have never been anything of that sort.
It's been you all along.
Because I don't care about anything.
Only someone who cares would choose to save the world.
M4 takes Lunasia's hand.
I want to give it a try.
Everything you've done is meaningless!
Just like Machlian's death!
Morridow plants a foot on Machlian's face.
The Commander clenches their fists, unable to hold their wrath back anymore.
It is NOT—
It is not meaningless.
A resolute voice sonorously interrupts Morridow's derisive laughter and the Commander's angry reply.
Dandelion raises her head. The light in her eyes has returned, but there is a different color to them.
Nobody's sacrifice is without value.
Because by relinquishing their lives, they will be giving the living something even more precious.
Dande...lion?
Oh come on, are you still pulling that crap at a time like this?
I don't care how much immunity—
Furious, ST AR-15 whirls around to glare at Dandelion, but the moment their eyes meet, all her angry words die in her throat.
She looks into those familiar eyes and whispers in a quivering voice.
What?!
Dandelion... M4?
Enough with the charade!
Exasperated by "Dandelion's" interruption, Narciss commands all her floating blades to pivot and take aim at the Commander.
Whoosh!
...Don't worry, Commander.
Whum...
As "Dandelion" reassures the Commander calmly, time seems to come to a halt around them.
The swarm of flying blades hang in mid-air, fixed in place like a scene from a video cassette with a cut tape.
W-What?!
Is that you... M4?
I'm back.
Time flows onward until M4 is back where she started.
She stares at the thread in Lunasia's hand in a daze. It has merely been extended a little and is almost at its end again...
...Were the changes I made meaningless?
I did say it was just a try.
To achieve the result you desire, you will have to try again and again and again.
...Alright, I will keep trying. I will merge with you.
I will hand over my memories, my feelings, all my data...
My soul and my life.
I'm giving them all to you.
Very well. Then you should get to work.
...Why am I here again?
...I think I'm starting to understand.
Me too.
Same here.
What do you mean? What do you understand?
We all witnessed your conversation with Lunasia.
Now we have a thorough understanding of everything that's happening, as well as what Leinad Kcaj wants us to do.
...What are you talking about? Who is Leinad Kcaj?
M16 averts her gaze. M4 notices something odd about RO and ST AR-15.
You're hiding something from me, aren't you?
ST AR-15 meets M4's gaze.
M4, do you still remember?
In your memory, the only ones who entered the Starfish System underneath the submarine base were you, 16, and Elisa...
Then how did you get here?
In the world that we abandoned, "Lunasia" died, and they are the three remaining members of the AR Team, right?
ST AR-15 turns away in silence and squeezes her eyes close with a pained expression.
What...? You...
RO, ST AR-15, and SOP-II are the AR Team from another world line.
They came here to save us and the Commander.
In their world line, I died at the Paldiski Submarine Base, while you returned from the Starfish System and fought alongside the Commander in Frankfurt.
We failed...
We're so sorry we couldn't save you or the Commander.
Coming here is our last chance.
RO feels a lump in the back of her throat. It is making it very hard to breathe.
You're aware that I'm not the M4 you know, so why are you still so hellbent on saving me?
You may not be our M4, but you're still our hope of salvation.
RO takes M4's hand gently and wipes away M4's tears as she once did.
Our world may be beyond salvation, but if the AR Team from some other world can still move forward with hope...
If the Commander can stay alive, and M4 won't perish on the battlefield, then...
Our actions will mean something.
It's time to make up your mind, M4.
...We are finally reunited after so much hardship...
...Why don't we just die together here?
Smack.
A crisp slap in the face.
Anybody can say something this selfish, but not you. You are carrying everyone's hope.
You must be strong. You must keep moving forward and reach the destination that's out of our reach.
M16 places her weapon in M4's hands.
We have traveled through time and all kinds of obstacles to be by your side.
You must remember our wish.
But then you'll all cease to exist...
What's the point in a world where only I remain?!
But there will be a world that won't end in destruction like all other worlds, a world that will be reborn.
In that world, SOP-II will still be bouncing around tearing things apart, the Commander will still be toiling away at the base...
And we will also be up to our usual business...
Perhaps the fate of countless worlds is already sealed, but as long as one world keeps the hope alive, then we will have succeeded.
This is why we came here in the first place.
The AR Team is the AR Team, wherever it is.
Why... why must I bear all this suffering...?
With tears streaming down her face, M4 raises the gun.
I know... I know which is the most rational and correct course of action...
But I don't want to make this choice... I don't want to lose you... I don't want to be on my own...
We have never left you, M4. We have always been by your side.
...Shoot.
For the sake of all that you cherish.
Who... are you?
I'm here to pick you up.
Pick me up? ...For what?
Just how dumb are you...
To bring you to meet the others.
Your friends. They're waiting for you.
Friends?
No one matches the definition of "friend" in my memory module.
Does that mean... I have no friends yet?
In that case, I'm your first friend.
If you don't do it, I'll do it myself.
No... I'll make my own decision...
M4A1... I have finally paid off what I owe you, haven't I?
That is my final wish. With that, I no longer owe this world anything, right?
But I can't stop thinking about how you'll burst into tears when you see me, the wimp that you are...
...I've been under the command of such a spineless weakling all this time... Seriously, how many times have you dragged me down?
I really should hate you, shouldn't I...?
Her tightly pursed lips tremble slightly as the emotions she has been fighting to suppress overwhelm her.
M4 lowers the gun and dares not look in the direction she just fired.
I've had enough... How much more pain... must I bear?
M16 stands next to M4 wordlessly.
Click.
RO disables the safety on her weapon and aims for her own neural core.
M4, I would've wanted you to do the honors, but if you can't bring yourself to do it...
I don't mind ending it myself.
RO!
RO gazes silently at M4.
Even though M4 knows the RO that she knows is still fighting in the real world, she can still feel a deep sense of trust and familiarity in these eyes.
RO, are you there?!
I told you I'd be back.
You can't see me, but I know you're here!
Why... why are you still here? I'm... already like this...
I don't care what you've become, M4A1. This is my mission.
But... we've only known each other for a few hours...
This is why I was created in the first place!
I was created... to save you at this very moment!
This shouldn't be what you live for...
Your purpose isn't even derived from your own free will!
So what?
At least right now, I'm happy. I'm happy to have met you and the AR Team.
Don't you understand? You're designed to feel that way! All T-Dolls are.
I can live with that! Why does it matter if my feelings are artificial or not?!
At the very least... I'm doing my best for what I believe is good...
My feelings might not be my own, but my smile is genuine!
AR-15 wanted me to save you. M16 wants me to save you. So does SOP-II as well as the Commander!
I might not be acting out of my own free will, but I'm doing this because everyone is counting on me.
Even if you don't believe me, at least believe those who have always supported you.
C'mon, take my hand. Let's go back together...
M4 grabs RO's hand and takes the gun away from her.
RO lets out a contented smile and closes her eyes calmly...
RO...
I'm sorry for forgetting...
I promised we would never be parted again.
I promised we would remain together... in victory and defeat.
M4 falls on her knees in quiet anguish.
M16 is still standing by her side.
Why... why me...
Why do you always leave me behind...
Because you're special.
Because every member of the AR Team exists for you—every last one of us...
M16 buries this cruel answer deep in her heart and simply smiles mirthlessly.
I'm still here.
M4, I'm always here.
Rustle... The golden sand dune hanging upside down is about to flow down through the crevice.
Don't go, M16!
M4 grasps the hem of M16's coat feebly.
I want to save you, but you're all leaving one after the other...
We never left.
They traveled across time and space—across worlds—to be by your side.
I know... That's why I'm... so scared...
I'm scared of letting everyone's effort go to waste...
I'm not sure if I can do it, 16. I've already lost my way once...
On your feet.
M16 pulls the despaired M4 off the ground.
Don't be afraid. Just find your courage and keep moving forward.
No matter how things are going to end, I will come and find you.
Maybe the M16 from this world can no longer gain access to this place, but another M16 will definitely come for you.
No matter what I'll turn into... wait for me.
You're so cruel, M16A1...
You're always the same, every single time...
Then hate me all you want.
Dong...
The bell in the garden tolls all of a sudden.
Hurry. The Commander is running out of time.
Right...
M4 raises the gun in her hand and presses the muzzle against M16's neural core.
Remember your promise. I will be waiting for you.
Sure. Wait for me.
M16 smiles softly.
